thread:
Aisha (CSE): hey team — incoming escalation from Theo at Valence Labs. Their Okta group push created the SCIM group but users aren't getting the mapped role in Redwood. Customer reports group shows on our side but role assignment missing. observed after an Okta change last night. 

Theo (Customer): "We pushed a rename + group externalId change on Okta. On our side the group exists in Redwood, but users still have old role until we manually re-sync. This is blocking a release." 

Aisha (CSE): copying minimal repro logs from their support bundle: 
```
PATCH /scim/Groups/00a1b2c3d4/members
body: [{"value":"user-abc123","display":"jane.doe@example.com"}]
response: 404 Not Found
{"detail":"Member with externalId 'user-abc123 ' not found"}
```
(note the trailing space in externalId reported)

Daniel (Eng): interesting — error message suggests we use externalId as the key when resolving members during group->role sync. if Okta pushed an externalId with accidental whitespace we could fail to resolve. do we have any normalization on ingestion? 

Harper (SRE): our SCIM ingestion pipeline trims some fields but not externalId in every code path. we do canonicalize usernames/email lowercasing in the user import flow, but group member lookups rely on exact externalId matching. sounds like a gap. 

Aisha (CSE): customer provided repro steps: 
1) In Okta, create group 'Mobile-Team' and set externalId to 'mobile-team-v2 ' (note trailing space)
2) Push group members via groupPush
3) Observe Redwood receives group but PATCH /Members fails with 404 (member not found) and users do not get role assigned

Daniel (Eng): can you attach the request/response IDs? we need the scim request id to trace. also which connector (okta-saml) and whether groupPush or SCIM SCIM API used. 

Aisha (CSE): attached ticket id CS-18345 and sample request id scim-req-3f2a. connector: Okta Group Push via SCIM. customer confirmed they only changed externalId formatting. 

okta-integration-bot: sync_report: 1 group push failed, 3 member mappings failed, next_retry in 15m.

Daniel (Eng): repro locally with a unit test: create a user with externalId 'user-abc123' and then a group push referencing 'user-abc123 ' (trailing space). current code path does a direct lookup in users_by_external_id map -> misses -> returns 404. fix is to normalize externalId on both ingestion and lookup (trim, unicode-normalize). i can whip up a small patch to trim and NFKC normalize externalId at point of lookup. 

Harper (SRE): we should be careful: normalizing at lookup is safest for immediate fix, but we should also backfill to correct stored externalIds. otherwise some analytics or auditing could still show inconsistent ids. plan: (1) hotfix lookup normalization and deploy, (2) run a migration that trims/normalizes existing externalIds and re-run member sync for groups that had failures, (3) add a golden test for whitespace/unicode variants. 

Aisha (CSE): customer asks for a mitigation they can run now. Theo says they can re-run group push but want automated; manual re-sync worked for them but too risky at scale. 

Daniel (Eng): short-term workaround: re-run Okta group push with a mapping rule that overwrites externalId to the normalized value (no trailing space) or run an export->reimport. but we're shipping the patch now. ETA for hotfix: ~3 hours for review + canary, then full rollout. 

deploy-bot: deploy started: eng-provisioning/hotfix-externalid-normalize -> canary -> 10%

Theo (Customer): thanks, appreciate the quick turnaround. can you also ensure future group pushes that include accidental leading/trailing whitespace don't silently fail? we had no alert except users lost roles. 

Aisha (CSE): noted. action items: 
- Daniel: PR to normalize externalId at member lookup + tests (in review, PR #4247) 
- Harper: schedule migration to normalize stored externalIds and reprocess failed group pushes (runbook drafted) 
- Aisha: keep customer updated, provide mitigation steps and CS ticket with remediation timeline 

Daniel (Eng): adding improving observability: if member resolution fails due to externalId mismatch, emit diagnostic hint: "externalId candidates (trimmed)" so CSEs can triage faster. adding that to PR. 

Aisha (CSE): great. tagging @Theo once we have canary pass. :thumbsup:

okta-integration-bot: canary success at 10% after 12m. no new sync failures observed for externalId-trim case.

Aisha (CSE): rolling to 100% now. updating CS-18345 with timeline and root cause summary. will follow up once migration completes.

Theo (Customer): confirmed roles propagated after the re-sync and noticed no further issues after the canary. thanks all. :tada:
